chunks: Ibn Abi Umayr narrated that from Hafs from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
In the pigeon, one dirham; and in the chick, half a dirham; and in the egg, a quarter of a dirham.

key_terms.الْحَمَامَة: Pigeon (specifically the common dove/pigeon used in this context)
key_terms.دِرْهَم: Dirham (a silver coin used as a unit of currency/value)

ai.seo_question: What is the compensation for accidentally killing a pigeon while in ihram?
ai.summary: Recorded by Ibn Abi Umayr from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) in al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith establishes a precise, graded monetary scale for the *kaffarah* of accidentally killing birds during *ihram*. The valuation reflects the bird's developmental stage—full dirham for a mature pigeon, half for a chick, and a quarter for an egg—demonstrating the Shia juristic emphasis on proportional compensation based on maturity and value.
